===FOREWORD===
{{Print version|Spanish_by_Choice/SpanishPod_lessons/Print version||these lessons}}
{{PDF version|Spanish_by_Choice_SpanishPod_Lessons|(corrected A0112, A0072)<br>File size: 937 KB}}
These lessons are based on [http://spanishpod.com/ SpanishPod] newbie lessons for beginners without knowledge of Spanish. The teaching language is English; there are no prerequisites. The lessons can be studied in any order; thus, you are free to choose lessons according to your preferences. It is not necessary to study all lessons; however, it is very recommendable to review the lessons as often as possible. 

An [[Spanish by Choice/SpanishPod dialogues|index of dialogue lines]] is available. It includes the lines of all lesson dialogues with translations and audio files.

An introduction to [[Spanish by Choice/SpanishPod grammar|Spanish grammar]] is also available. This introduction is particularly useful to look up grammar terms that appear in the vocabulary lists of the lessons.
